# kion_dashboard (Resource)

Manages a Kion Dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_dashboard" "example" {
  # Optional
  # config      = "example"
  # description = "example"
  # is_default  = false
  # name        = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `config` (String) JSON configuration (cards
- `description` (String) Description of the dashboard.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default dashboard.
- `name` (String) Name of the dashboard.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the dashboard was created.
- `created_by_user_id` (Number) ID of the user who created the dashboard.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String) When the dashboard was last updated.
